content_sections.heading: Project Details and Duties
content_sections.text: The project is titled "The Study of the Impact of Injection Fluids on the Performance of a Producing Coal Bed Methane (CBM) Reservoir in the Raniganj East Block". content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF and Project Associate-I Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The Rs. 37,000/- JRF fellowship is for scholars selected through either of these routes: National Eligibility Tests: CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE A selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions The Rs. 30,000/- Project Associate-I fellowship is for others who do not fall under these routes.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF and Project Associate-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 28 years at the time of appointment. Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through a process described in any one of the following: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests: CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Experience/Knowledge in the relevant fields. Relaxation in the upper age limit will be given to SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy layer)/Female candidates as per GOI rules. Check the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible and selected candidates will be called for an interview, which will be in Hybrid Mode.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The tenure of the project is 13 months or the end of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF and Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a hard copy of your application with attested copies of all degree and experience certificates. Send the hard copy by speed post to the Principal Investigator: Prof. Archana, Assistant Professor, Department of Petroleum Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines), Dhanbad-826 004, Jharkhand. Also send your application through email to [email protected] . Mention the project number, SRDP14041, on the subject of the application. For queries, the notice lists the Principal Investigator's mobile number as 9471191527.

faq.question: Q1. What decides whether I get Rs. 37,000/- or Rs. 30,000/-?
faq.answer: The higher amount goes to JRF scholars selected through CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or a qualifying National level examination. Others who do not fall under this group receive the Project Associate-I amount of Rs. 30,000/-.

faq.question: Q2. Which agencies' national level examinations are accepted?
faq.answer: The notice names DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER and NISER as examples.

faq.question: Q3. Is experience compulsory for this position?
faq.answer: No experience is listed under the essential qualification. Experience or knowledge in the relevant fields appears only as a desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents should I send with the application?
faq.answer: Attach attested copies of all degree and experience certificates to the hard copy.

faq.question: Q5. Which sponsor is funding this project?
faq.answer: ESSAR Oil and Gas Ltd is the sponsor, under a sanction letter dated 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Can I attend the interview remotely?
faq.answer: The interview is in Hybrid Mode, tentatively at 10.00 am. The notice does not explain how the hybrid arrangement works, so confirm your mode with the Principal Investigator.
